mapper.sql: SELECT M.MATCH_ID, M.LOST_ID, M.FOUND_ID, M.MATCH_SCORE, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(M.MATCH_REASON, 1000, 1) AS MATCH_REASON, M.MATCH_STATUS, M.CREATED_AT, L.TITLE AS LOST_TITLE, L.ITEM_NAME AS LOST_ITEM_NAME, F.TITLE AS FOUND_TITLE, F.ITEM_NAME AS FOUND_ITEM_NAME, LOC.LOCATION_NAME AS FOUND_LOCATION_NAME, F.FOUND_LOCATION_DETAIL, IMG.IMAGE_URL FROM ITEM_MATCHES M JOIN LOST_ITEMS L ON L.LOST_ID = M.LOST_ID JOIN FOUND_ITEMS F ON F.FOUND_ID = M.FOUND_ID LEFT JOIN LOCATIONS LOC ON LOC.LOCATION_ID = F.FOUND_LOCATION_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ITEM_ID, MIN(IMAGE_URL) AS IMAGE_URL FROM ITEM_IMAGES WHERE ITEM_TYPE = 'found' GROUP BY ITEM_ID ) IMG ON IMG.ITEM_ID = F.FOUND_ID
mapper.select: WHERE M.LOST_ID = #{lostId} ORDER BY M.MATCH_SCORE DESC, M.CREATED_AT DESC
WHERE L.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY M.CREATED_AT DESC
